# AICloudStrategist

> A professional consultancy focused on one service: the Cloud & AI Cost Governance Diagnostic.

## Primary service
- [Cloud & AI Cost Governance Diagnostic](https://aicloudstrategist.com/cloud-ai-cost-governance-diagnostic/): a bounded review that connects cloud, Kubernetes, GPU, model, inference and data-platform costs to workloads, products, owners, evidence gaps and safe next actions.

## Decision enabled
The diagnostic helps technology and finance leaders understand where included cloud and AI spend goes, which workloads and owners create it, where cost remains shared or unallocated, and which actions should be classified as act, investigate, hold or reject.

## Client outputs
- Reconciled cost and ownership baseline.
- Allocation and ownership map.
- Cost-driver assessment.
- Governance gap register.
- Prioritized decision register.
- 30-day customer action plan.

## Evidence and boundaries
- [Representative Cloud & AI Cost Governance Decision Pack](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/cloud-ai-economics-decision-pack/): a representative synthetic scenario, not customer work, a benchmark, an achieved result or a savings promise.
- [Trust & Data Handling](https://aicloudstrategist.com/trust-data-handling/): website enquiry and diagnostic-evidence boundaries.
- No guaranteed savings, fixed ROI, autonomous shutdowns or production changes are promised.
- Missing evidence, ownership gaps, assumptions and client approval requirements remain explicit.
